provenance.method: Bounded first-party review for the Organisations & peer community UK v1 reference slice; inclusion records identity, access and scope without endorsing quality, safety or outcomes.

name: People First (Self Advocacy)
description: National user-led self-advocacy organisation run by and for people with learning difficulties or learning disabilities, including autistic people within its stated scope, with individual members and member self-advocacy organisations.
intended_use: Finding a user-led self-advocacy organisation and map of member organisations where governance by people represented is central to the model.
audience_or_context: People with learning difficulties or learning disabilities, including autistic people within People First's stated scope, and self-advocacy organisations.
limitations: People First is not a directory for every neurodivergent condition.
Member organisations are independent and need their own current accessibility, safeguarding and service-quality checks.
User-led governance is not a universal quality or safety guarantee.
cost_or_access_notes: Individual and eligible self-advocacy organisation membership is described as free on the reviewed membership route.
